paite: Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa asi chih atheih in, athou a, kumpipa tapa tengteng athat vek hi.
heading: Judah Kumpinu Athaliah / (2 Kro 22.10-23.15)

paite: Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa Jehoram tanu, Ahaziah sanggamnu Jehosheba in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a pan pimang in, adontu toh lupna dantan ah a-omsak a; Athaliah muh theih louh ding in asel ua, huchi in thah ahita kei hi.
Amah bel amah toh TOUPA' inn ah kum guk akibu ua, huchi in Athaliah in huai gam ah vai ahawmta hi.

Akum sagihna ah Jehoiada in Keroth mite leh galvil sepaihte lak a mi sepaih za heutute asamsak a, TOUPA' inn ah akiang ah apilutsak hi. Akiang uah thu akhung a, TOUPA' inn ah akichiamsak a, kumpipa tapa amusak hi.
Ama'n, “Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi. Na lak ua Sabbath ni a hong dingte seh thum suah seh khat in kumpipa' inn na veng ding uh.
Seh thum suah seh khat bel Sur kulh kongpi ah na om ding uh. Huchibang in na veng ding ua, asiat ding na dal ding uhi.
Na lak ua pawl nih, Sabbath ni a pai dingte'n kumpipa kiang ah TOUPA' inn na veng ding uhi.
Michih in galvan tawi in kumpipa na umsuak ding ua; kuapeuh huai huamsung a hong lut na thah zel ding uh ahi. Huchi in kumpipa alut leh apawt zui vialvial un," chi in thu apia hi.
Sepaih za heutute'n siampu Jehoiada thupiak bangbang in ahih ua; amau heutu chiat Sabbath ni a hong dingte leh Sabbath ni a pai dingte api ua, siampu Jehoiada kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Siampu in sepaih za heutute TOUPA' inn a om, kumpipa David teipite leh lumte apia hi.
Galvil sepaihte'n galvan tawi chiat in, Tempul sik taklam a kipan veilam tan in maitam leh inn zul ah kumpipa a ding in umkhum uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia a, lallukhu akhusak hi. Theihsakna thu apia a; kumpipa in abawl ua, sathau anilh ua; akhut uh abeng ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen,” achi uhi.
Galvilmi leh mipite husa Athaliah in ana zak in, TOUPA' inn ah mipite lak ah ava hoh hi.

A-en a, ngai in, kumpipa dan dungzui in khuam zul ah ana dingh a, sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite bel kumpipa kiangnai ah adingh uhi. Huai gam mite'n nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkul amut uh. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Guksawmna! Guksawmna ahita ve!" chi in akikou hi.

Siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutute dia aseh sepaih za heutute thu apia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak in. Kuapeuh amah zui namsau a satlup ding ahi," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn a thah ding ahi kei," ana chita ngal a.
Huchi in aman ua; kumpipa' inn a sakolte lutna lampi a pai in, huai ah athatta uh.
Jehoiada in TOUPA leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal ah TOUPA mite ahihna ding un thukhun abawl hi.
heading: Jehoiada Puahthaknate / (2 Kro 23.16-21)

paite: Huai gammi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihchim ua; amaitamte leh alimte ahihnen dimdem ua, Baal siampu Mattan leng maitam bul ah athat uh. Huchi in siampu in TOUPA' inn vengmi heutute asepta hi.

Ama'n sepaih za heutute, veng mite, galvil sepaihte leh huai gam a mi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a pan kumpipa apikhia ua, galvil mite kongpi tawn in kumpipa' inn a lut in, kumpipa laltutphah ah atuta hi.
Huchi in huai gam a mi tengteng akipak ua, khopi buai lou in a-omta hi; Athaliah namsau in kumpipa' inn ah athat uhi.
Joash in vai ahawm pat lai in kum sagih a upa ahi.
